Variants.Content: The Golden Dragon, Silver Deer and Bronze Star allow different classes to discuss value on the same scale, but they do not bring the same purchasing power. Nobles settle big deals with gold, citizens bargain for a few bronze stars, and remote villages may still place more trust in food, salt, and working animals.
